target_definition: Nonnegative wind generation; signed raw features retained; target transform must be declared by supplied dataset
comparison_policy: Identical training, calibration, scoring observations and fourteen features. No tuning, early stopping or controller selection on scoring outcomes.
uncertainty_claim: Empirical development coverage only. Recency weights are heuristic under dependence; no exchangeability/conditional/simultaneous coverage guarantee is asserted.
online_policy: Frozen model; predeclared residual updates only after target < decision AND actual/residual availability <= decision. No model refitting on scored observations.
